items.informal_name: Evaluation Identity (Eta Conversion) for Multivariate Polynomials
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : MvPolynomial σ R),
  MvPolynomial.eval₂ MvPolynomial.C MvPolynomial.X p = p
items.informal_description: For any multivariate polynomial $ p $ in variables $ \sigma $ with coefficients in a commutative semiring $ R $, evaluating $ p $ using the constant polynomial embedding $ C : R \to R[\sigma] $ and identity variable mapping $ X : \sigma \to R[\sigma] $ yields the original polynomial $ p $. Symbolically, $ \text{eval}_2(C, X)(p) = p $. This expresses that the canonical evaluation map is the identity when coefficients are embedded as constants and variables are mapped to themselves.

items.informal_description: For any commutative semiring $ R $, types $ \sigma $ and $ \tau $, and a function $ f : \sigma \to R[\tau] $, applying the substitution homomorphism $ \text{bind}_1(f) $ to the variable $ X_i \in R[\sigma] $ yields $ f(i) $. In symbols, $ \text{bind}_1(f)(X_i) = f(i) $.

  MvPolynomial.bind₁ MvPolynomial.X = AlgHom.id R (MvPolynomial σ R)
items.informal_description: Substituting each variable in the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[\sigma] $ with itself results in the identity algebra homomorphism. That is, the variable substitution homomorphism induced by the identity map $ X : \sigma \to R[\sigma] $ is equal to the identity function on $ R[\sigma] $.

items.informal_name: Algebra Equivalence for Multivariate Polynomials with Incremented Index Type
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) [inst : CommSemiring R] (n : ℕ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R),
  (MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv R n) p =
    (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (Polynomial.C.comp MvPolynomial.C) fun i =>
        Fin.cases Polynomial.X (fun k => Polynomial.C (MvPolynomial.X k)) i)
      p
items.informal_description: There is an algebra equivalence between the ring of multivariate polynomials over $ \text{Fin}(n+1) $ with coefficients in a commutative semiring $ R $, and the polynomial ring in one variable whose coefficients are multivariate polynomials over $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \text{Fin}(n) $. This equivalence is constructed via the bijection $ \text{Fin}(n+1) \simeq \text{Option}(\text{Fin}(n)) $, mapping the $ \text{none} $ case to the outer polynomial indeterminate and $ \text{some } k $ cases to inner variables. The equivalence preserves addition, multiplication, and scalar multiplication by elements of $ R $.

items.informal_description: Applying the variable substitution homomorphism with the identity map on multivariate polynomials $ R[\sigma] $ is equivalent to the flattening homomorphism that reduces nested polynomial structures to a single polynomial layer.

items.informal_name: Univariate Embedding Equals Rename Composition in Multivariate Polynomials
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] (i : σ),
  Polynomial.toMvPolynomial i = (MvPolynomial.rename fun x => i).comp ↑(MvPolynomial.pUnitAlgEquiv R).symm
items.informal_description: The algebra homomorphism embedding a univariate polynomial ring $ R[X] $ into the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[\sigma] $ by substituting $ X $ with the $ i $-th variable in $ \sigma $ is equal to the composition of the inverse of the algebra equivalence between $ R[\mathsf{PUnit}] $ and $ R[X] $ with the renaming of variables from $ \mathsf{PUnit} $ to the $ i $-th variable in $ \sigma $.

items.informal_name: Default Homomorphism Between Algebras with Generators
items.type:
{R : Type u} →
  {S : Type v} →
    {ι : Type w} →
      [inst : CommRing R] →
        [inst_1 : CommRing S] →
          [inst_2 : Algebra R S] →
            (P : Algebra.Generators R S ι) →
              {R' : Type u_1} →
                {S' : Type u_2} →
                  {ι' : Type u_3} →
                    [inst_3 : CommRing R'] →
                      [inst_4 : CommRing S'] →
                        [inst_5 : Algebra R' S'] →
                          (P' : Algebra.Generators R' S' ι') ...
items.informal_description: The default homomorphism from algebra $ P $ to algebra $ P' $ is defined by composing the generator map $ P.	ext{val} $ (mapping indices $\iota$ to elements of $ S $), the algebra homomorphism $ \text{algebraMap} $ from $ S $ to $ S' $, and the polynomial representation map $ P'.\sigma $ (expressing elements of $ S' $ as polynomials in its generators). This composition ensures compatibility with the algebra structures, making it a valid algebra homomorphism in the $ \text{Hom} $ type.

items.informal_name: Algebra homomorphism induced by generator mapping
items.type:
{R : Type u} →
  {S : Type v} →
    {ι : Type w} →
      [inst : CommRing R] →
        [inst_1 : CommRing S] →
          [inst_2 : Algebra R S] →
            {P : Algebra.Generators R S ι} →
              {R' : Type u_1} →
                {S' : Type u_2} →
                  {ι' : Type u_3} →
                    [inst_3 : CommRing R'] →
                      [inst_4 : CommRing S'] →
                        [inst_5 : Algebra R' S'] →
                          {P' : Algebra.Generators R' S' ι'} ...
items.informal_description: Given a homomorphism $ f $ between algebras $ P $ and $ P' $ with generators, this constructs the canonical $ R $-algebra homomorphism from $ P.	ext{Ring} $ to $ P'.	ext{Ring} $ by evaluating multivariate polynomials using the underlying function $ f.	ext{val} $ that maps generators. This evaluation preserves the algebra structure, sending each polynomial to its image under the generator assignment defined by $ f $.

items.informal_name: Compatibility of Algebra Homomorphism with Polynomial Evaluation on Generators
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {ι : Type w} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S]
  {P : Algebra.Generators R S ι} {R' : Type u_1} {S' : Type u_2} {ι' : Type u_3} [inst_3 : CommRing R']
  [inst_4 : CommRing S'] [inst_5 : Algebra R' S'] {P' : Algebra.Generators R' S' ι'} [inst_6 : Algebra S S']
  (self : P.Hom P') (i : ι), (MvPolynomial.aeval P'.val) (self.val i) = (algebraMap S S') (P.val i)
items.informal_description: For any algebra homomorphism between generator sets and any generator index $i$, evaluating the multivariate polynomial using the target generators' values at the image of $i$ under the homomorphism equals applying the algebra homomorphism from $S$ to $S'$ to the value of the original generator at $i$. Symbolically: $\text{aeval}_{P'}(\text{self.val}(i)) = \text{algebraMap}(S, S')(P.\text{val}(i))$.

items.informal_name: Default Homomorphism on Generators via Algebra Maps and Polynomial Representations
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {ι : Type w} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S]
  (P : Algebra.Generators R S ι) {R' : Type u_1} {S' : Type u_2} {ι' : Type u_3} [inst_3 : CommRing R']
  [inst_4 : CommRing S'] [inst_5 : Algebra R' S'] (P' : Algebra.Generators R' S' ι') [inst_6 : Algebra S S'] (a : ι),
  (P.defaultHom P').val a = (P'.σ ∘ ⇑(algebraMap S S') ∘ P.val) a
items.informal_description: For each generator index $\iota$, the default homomorphism between algebras with generators maps $\iota$ to the composition of three operations: (1) the generator valuation map $P.\text{val}$ sending $\iota$ to elements of $S$, (2) the canonical algebra homomorphism $\text{algebraMap}: S \to S'$, and (3) the polynomial representation map $P'.\sigma$ expressing elements of $S'$ as polynomials in the target algebra's generators. This composition defines how the homomorphism acts on generators while preserving algebraic structure.

items.informal_name: Universal Property of Free Algebra
items.type:
(R : Type u_1) →
  {X : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CommSemiring R] →
      {A : Type u_3} → [inst_1 : Semiring A] → [inst_2 : Algebra R A] → (X → A) ≃ (FreeAlgebra R X →ₐ[R] A)
items.informal_description: The equivalence between functions from a generating set $ X $ to an $ R $-algebra $ A $ and $ R $-algebra homomorphisms from the free algebra $ \text{FreeAlgebra}(R, X) $ to $ A $. This establishes that every function $ f : X → A $ extends uniquely to an $ R $-algebra homomorphism $ \text{FreeAlgebra}(R, X) → A $, preserving addition, multiplication, and scalar multiplication by $ R $, while respecting the quotient relations that make scalars central in the free algebra.

items.informal_name: Underlying function of a homomorphism between algebras with generators
items.type:
{R : Type u} →
  {S : Type v} →
    {ι : Type w} →
      [inst : CommRing R] →
        [inst_1 : CommRing S] →
          [inst_2 : Algebra R S] →
            {P : Algebra.Generators R S ι} →
              {R' : Type u_1} →
                {S' : Type u_2} →
                  {ι' : Type u_3} →
                    [inst_3 : CommRing R'] →
                      [inst_4 : CommRing S'] →
                        [inst_5 : Algebra R' S'] →
                          {P' : Algebra.Generators R' S' ι'} ...
items.informal_description: The function component of a homomorphism between algebras generated over commutative rings, mapping each generator indexed by $\iota$ to an element in the ring of the target algebra's generators indexed by $\iota'$, preserving the algebraic structure and scalar multiplication compatibility.

items.informal_name: Evaluation of Generator-Induced Polynomial Equals Original Element
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {ι : Type w} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S]
  (self : Algebra.Generators R S ι) (s : S), (MvPolynomial.aeval self.val) (self.σ' s) = s
items.informal_description: For any commutative ring $ R $, commutative $ R $-algebra $ S $, and index type $ \iota $, given an algebra generator structure on $ S $ with generators indexed by $ \iota $, the evaluation of the multivariate polynomial representation $ \sigma'(s) $ (expressing $ s \in S $ as an $ R $-linear combination of monomials in the generators) under the canonical algebra homomorphism $ R[\iota] \to S $ recovers the original element $ s $. In symbols: $ \operatorname{aeval}(\sigma'(s)) = s $ for all $ s \in S $.

items.informal_name: Algebra Map Equals Polynomial Evaluation
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {ι : Type w} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S]
  (P : Algebra.Generators R S ι) (x : P.Ring), (algebraMap P.Ring S) x = (MvPolynomial.aeval P.val) x
items.informal_description: For any element $x$ in the commutative ring $R$, the canonical algebra homomorphism $\text{algebraMap}(R \to S)$ evaluated at $x$ is equal to the evaluation of the multivariate polynomial $P.\text{val}$ (the generators of the algebra $S$ over $R$) at $x$, i.e., $\text{algebraMap}(R \to S)(x) = \text{aeval}_{R, S}(P.\text{val})(x)$.

∀ {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {S₂ : Type w} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁]
  [inst_2 : CommSemiring S₂] [inst_3 : Algebra R S₁] [inst_4 : Algebra R S₂] (f : S₁ →ₐ[R] S₂) (p : MvPolynomial σ S₁),

items.name: MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁] [inst_2 : Algebra R S₁]
  (f : σ → S₁) {B : Type u_2} [inst_3 : CommSemiring B] [inst_4 : Algebra R B] (φ : S₁ →ₐ[R] B) (p : MvPolynomial σ R),
  φ ((MvPolynomial.aeval f) p) = (MvPolynomial.aeval fun i => φ (f i)) p
